_comment_path: Replace <HOME> with your absolute home path. JetBrains AI does NOT expand ~ or $HOME. Use the platform home directory form for macOS, Linux, or Windows.
_comment_windows: On Windows the venv layout differs — replace `bin/python3` with `Scripts/python.exe` so the command becomes `<HOME>/.local/b12-venv/Scripts/python.exe`. Forward slashes work fine inside JSON on Windows.
